name: S-Oil Corporation
summary: S-OIL Corporation is a major South Korean enterprise primarily engaged in oil refining. The company's extensive product line encompasses various refined petroleum products, including gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, kerosene, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), fuel oil, and asphalt. Additionally, it manufactures a broad spectrum of petrochemicals such as benzene, toluene, xylene (including para-xylene), propylene, methyl tert-butyl ether, propylene oxide, and polypropylene, alongside a range of lubricant products. S-OIL maintains substantial operational infrastructure, including crude oil refining facilities with a daily capacity of 669,000 barrels, dedicated plants for producing lube base oil and other petrochemicals, and a bunker-C cracking center that further processes petroleum. The company has a significant international footprint, distributing its refined and petrochemical goods to numerous global markets, notably across Southeast Asia, the United States, China, Japan, Australia, and Europe. Founded in 1976 and headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, S-OIL Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Aramco Overseas Co., B.V.
